rawPayload.Product_Description_Legacy:
The Bosch WTMC8530UC from the Nexxt 800 Series is a high-performance 27-inch gas dryer engineered for efficient, fabric-friendly drying with advanced control and quiet operation. Designed with a spacious 6.7 cu. ft. capacity, it accommodates large loads while delivering consistent results through intelligent moisture sensing and precision drying programs.
Featuring 15 specialized drying cycles, including MISTCARE™ refresh options, this model helps reduce wrinkles, eliminate odors, and maintain garment quality without excessive heat exposure. Bosch’s ECOSENSOR™ technology automatically adjusts drying time based on moisture levels, optimizing energy efficiency and preventing over-drying.
